summary: Refinement pass on Shipment Detail (customer-facing) validated end-to-end via Playwright at desktop 1440x900 and mobile 390x844. Executed every scenario from the request: mock login -> shipments list -> IS-0012 detail. Hero: id/pill/factory/6 facts (ships-in 'in 112 days'), rail 'Released · Stage 5 of 7 · 71%' with 4 done + 1 current + next-step chip. Overview: requirements card, 100 lines rendering, filter 'GOAT' -> 9 rows / '9 of 100 lines' / subtotal $2,688.00; 'zzz' -> lines-empty; cleared -> 100 rows / $18,675.00. Side cards: 3 quick-docs, 3 recent-activity, docs-view-all / activity-view-all / help-message / hero-message navigations work. Booking: si-method 'Freight forwarder', mailto link present; edited transport to Air -> si-transport-value updates AND hero Mode fact updates to Air; prepay-amount $9,337.50; 2 schedule rows; prepay-receipt toast; both cards equal height (0px diff at 1440w). Conversation: 3 seeded msgs w/ GO/RM avatars, mine right-aligned, '3 messages', chat-send disabled empty, Enter appends chat-msg-3 -> badge '4' & '4 messages'. Documents: docs-download-all toast, all 3 doc buttons visible, coo-toggle-detail flips coo-state text, removes certificate item, and Documents badge 3<->2. Activity: activity-0..4 visible. IS-0007: no ships-in / no next-step, current stage 'Invoiced' (6 done), 2 lines. Mobile 390: no horizontal overflow, facts grid = 2 columns, chat avatars display:none. Back pill returns to list.
critical_code_review_comments: ShipmentDetail.tsx (218 lines, very dense one-liners) still readable but each tab body would benefit from extraction into subcomponents; JSX lines are hard to diff.
seedMsgs uses hard-coded times ('9:27 PM', '9:31 PM', '12:49 AM'); activity list also uses fixed strings. Cosmetic but 'Message sent to Goorin · 3:29 AM' is not tied to any real user action.
tab-conversation badge = msgs.length (message count, not unread). Fine for a prototype but worth flagging: badge grows with every send.

nextHint map only defines Shipped/Invoiced/Released — falls back to generic string for other stages; OK because earlier stages already have a current stage, but map could be exhaustive for the 7 stages.

si state duplicates fields from Shipment (forwarder, transport) rather than deriving; when editing, changes are only reflected via the local si state, not written back to the shared shipment object — acceptable for mock but note if this ever needs to persist across navigation.
test_credentials: Mock login: click 'Log in' with empty fields.

Login button label is 'Log in' (lowercase 'in').
